purpose: Describe an action’s effect being repeatedly undone immediately.
keywords: V dictionary / た + そばから
As fast as I tidy up, the children make a mess again.
I forget words almost as soon as I learn them.
Raindrops keep landing as soon as I wipe the window.
formation: V dictionary / た + そばから
restrictions: Usually a recurring pattern, not one isolated occurrence.
mistake: For one immediate event, use a simple time expression instead.
